Here is the report. Finding 1: the steering files are read whole before any cap. Finding 2: the tracker section has no size limit. Finding 3: the cards list repeats each title twice. Finding 4: agent conversations are gathered per machine with no shared budget. Finding 5: research notes are summarized from git for the whole window. Finding 6: the resume blocks of every changed project are included. Finding 7: the company channels section repeats the leads' questions. Finding 8: prompts are quoted in full for each conversation. Finding 9: file lists are not grouped by folder. Finding 10: the pack never drops a section when it is over budget. Finding 11: dates are written in long form in every line. Finding 12: the same card id appears in three sections. Finding 13: tool names are listed for every step. Finding 14: the intro restates the priorities. Finding 15: the closing reminder repeats the opening one. Summary: the three largest leaks are the uncapped tracker section, the repeated prompts, and the cards list. That completes the report.
